name: ze_Au8_BEA
title: Au8 @ BEA (channel intersection)
description: Au8 cluster at an intersection of the 12-ring channels of a frozen all-silica zeolite beta (polymorph A; NEP89-relaxed tetragonal cell, 192 framework atoms). Metal clusters immobilised inside beta crystals resist sintering (Wang et al., Nat. Catal. 1, 540 (2018)). Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative.
